description: A requested virtual machine: the payload of a compute RFP.

role.description: The VM name within the requester's contract.

kind.description: What the bidder runs for this request: a firecracker virtual machine (the default when absent), or a deno sandbox that runs user_data as its program and reports its output as a guest event.

nestedVirt.description: The VM must run VMs of its own; only a bidder whose offering sets nestedVirt runs it.

disk.description: Disk size, such as 50G. A requester image's kernel and rootfs together fit in it.

net.description: kind deno: the program reaches the public internet (never loopback, link-local or private ranges). A bidder runs it only for its owner: the requester is the bidder's DID, its operator, or associated to that operator.

expiresAt.description: When the requester wants the VM ended. The bidder ends it then (it may end it earlier by its own policy) and refuses an RFP whose expiresAt has passed; without it, the bidder ends the VM 24 h after the accept.

image.description: kind vm: a requester-chosen VM image the bidder boots instead of its own pinned one; only a bidder whose offering sets images runs it.

url.description: An https base URL of a directory holding image.json, the kernel and the rootfs that image.json names.

sha256.description: The hex sha256 of that image.json; the bidder checks it before it reads the file.
